## Status

todo

## Summary

command-routing.json получает `orchestration.launch.<role>.<provider>` (5 ролей × claude-code/codex/grok) с model_class вместо модели; валидатор command_catalog проверяет форму, плейсхолдеры, запрет `--bare`; scout берёт запись из `launch.scout` (модель через class_selectors), legacy `orchestration.scout` — fallback; argv scout побайтно прежний.

## Why

R4, R3, I8, I12: один источник запуска для scout и будущего engine (D6); модели только из mappings.

## Rules

- Legacy-ключ `orchestration.scout` остаётся допустимым в чужих конфигах (fallback), в репозитории — удалён (I9)
- Любой элемент argv, равный `--bare`, — ошибка валидатора (I12)
- Если model_set == supported, argv содержит `{model}`
- Существующие 23 теста scout зелёные без правок

## Guidance

Исполнитель: Sonnet (claude-code, implementation/high) — лучше не экономить: побайтно прежний argv scout, валидатор, запрет --bare.

Форма записи `orchestration.launch.<role>.<provider>` (все поля обязательные):
`{"model_class": economy|implementation|frontier, "effort": low|…, "transport": "text"|"jsonl"|"acp", "argv": [str…], "timeout_s": int>0, "model_set": "supported"|"unknown"}`.
Роли: `scout`, `executor`, `bounded-implementer`, `reviewer`, `registrar`. Плейсхолдеры: `{model}`, `{effort}`, `{cwd}`.

| role | provider | model_class/effort | transport | argv | timeout_s | model_set |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| scout | claude-code | economy/low | text | `["claude","-p","--model","{model}","--effort","{effort}","--tools","","--no-session-persistence"]` (как сейчас) | 300 | supported |
| scout | codex | economy/low | text | `["codex","-a","never","exec","--sandbox","read-only","--model","{model}","-c","model_reasoning_effort=\"{effort}\"","--ephemeral","-"]` (как сейчас) | 300 | supported |
| executor | claude-code | implementation/high | jsonl | `["claude","-p","--output-format","stream-json","--verbose","--model","{model}","--effort","{effort}","--permission-mode","acceptEdits","--no-session-persistence"]` | 3600 | supported |
| executor | codex | implementation/high | jsonl | `["codex","-a","never","exec","--json","--sandbox","workspace-write","--model","{model}","-c","model_reasoning_effort=\"{effort}\"","-"]` | 3600 | supported |
| executor | grok | implementation/high | acp | `["grok","agent","stdio"]` | 3600 | unknown |
| bounded-implementer | claude-code / codex / grok | economy/medium | как executor | как executor | 1800 | как executor |
| reviewer | claude-code | implementation/high | jsonl | `["claude","-p","--output-format","stream-json","--verbose","--model","{model}","--effort","{effort}","--disallowedTools","Edit,Write,NotebookEdit","--no-session-persistence"]` | 1800 | supported |
| reviewer | codex | implementation/high | jsonl | `["codex","-a","never","exec","--json","--sandbox","read-only","--model","{model}","-c","model_reasoning_effort=\"{effort}\"","-"]` | 1800 | supported |
| reviewer | grok | implementation/high | acp | `["grok","agent","stdio"]` | 1800 | unknown |
| registrar | claude-code | economy/low | jsonl | `["claude","-p","--output-format","stream-json","--verbose","--model","{model}","--effort","{effort}","--tools","Bash,Read","--no-session-persistence"]` | 600 | supported |
| registrar | codex | economy/low | jsonl | `["codex","-a","never","exec","--json","--sandbox","workspace-write","--model","{model}","-c","model_reasoning_effort=\"{effort}\"","-"]` | 600 | supported |

Grok scout не добавляется (прежнее поведение «no scout entry» сохраняется). Argv — декларация для Plan 2; проверка на реальных CLI — probe Plan 2.

Тест-кейсы test_launch_catalog.py: репозиторный конфиг валиден; `_argv` scout для claude-code и codex совпадает с прежними списками (литералы в тесте) и модель = `haiku` / `gpt-5.6-luna`; конфиг только с legacy `scout` → scout работает; `--bare` в argv → CMD_ORCHESTRATION_INVALID; неизвестный плейсхолдер → ошибка; неизвестная роль → ошибка; provider без mapping → ошибка; scout с transport ≠ text → ошибка.
